newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed up by 0.57 percent in active trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index was 501.68 from 498.84 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 2.172 million dinars against 750,972 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air was up 0.89 dinar to 20.78 dinars with 10,484 shares changing hands. Banque de Tunisie rose 0.92 dinar to 75.02 dinars. Milk firm Tunisie Lait advanced 1.64 dinars to 22.06 dinars.
